/* C の見本 */
#include <stdio.h>
#include "local.h"
#define MAX(a, b) ((a) > (b) ? (a) : (b))
#define STR(x) #x
#if defined(__APPLE__) && !defined(NDEBUG)
#  pragma once
#elif 0
#error "unreachable"
#endif

typedef struct node { int value; struct node *next; } node_t;
enum color { RED = 1, GREEN = 1 << 1, BLUE = 0x4 };
static const char *names[] = { "red", "green", [2] = "blue" };
extern volatile unsigned long long counter;

static inline int sum(const int *xs, size_t n) {
    int total = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) total += xs[i];
    return total;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    char buf[64] = {0};
    float f = 1.5e-3f; double d = .5; long l = 10L; unsigned u = 7u;
    node_t *head = malloc(sizeof *head);
    if (!head) { perror("malloc"); return 1; }
    switch (argc) { case 1: puts("one"); break; default: goto done; }
    snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%s=%d\n", argv[0], MAX(argc, 2));
    char c = '\'', w = L'x';
done:
    free(head);
    return (int)(f + d + l + u + c + w);
}
